title: OcrReading
description: Payload: one reading of a tracked spine, with the condition it was taken under (INV-20). Readings of one track with the same condition are one observation, however many there are and however far apart in time; a band may rise only on agreeing readings under different conditions. OcrReading is where the key lives; the counting rule is observationCount in src/ledger/live.ts.

source.description: 'fast' and 'accurate' are single Vision passes; 'fused' is a fusion of several readings of this condition (T-3).

frameIndices.description: The frames the reading was taken from.
